title: bug: keystore RSA sign/decrypt unguarded *siglen cast to word32
description: In wp11_backend_keystore.c:128, (word32)*siglen is cast without a UINT32_MAX guard and passed directly to wc_RsaSSL_Sign as the output buffer length. If *siglen>UINT32_MAX the truncated value tells wolfCrypt the output buffer is smaller than it is, potentially causing wolfCrypt to overwrite past the declared limit. Same pattern at lines 351-352 for wc_RsaPrivateDecrypt (both ctlen and *ptlen). The soft backend (wp11_backend_soft.c:552) guards these explicitly. Fix: add UINT32_MAX guards before all casts.
